description: Microbenchmark envelope for grouped_gemm (scalar) vs grouped_gemm_tiled (tile/blocked scalar) at the canonical Qwen-MoE shape and the production-stress shape. Median over ITERS=20 timed runs after WARMUP=3 warmup calls, measured with std::time::Instant. This file is the seed baseline; the bench harness will rewrite it whenever OMLX_BENCH_DUMP=1 is set.
